title: Ensure 'Configure SMB v1 client driver' is set to 'Enabled: Disable driver'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MS Security Guide\Configure SMB v1 client driver to 'Enabled: Disable driver'
reason: The SMBv1 protocol is legacy and highly vulnerable to attacks like ransomware. Disabling the client driver ensures the server cannot initiate outbound SMBv1 connections.
